channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Connect to messaging platforms as a real bot. Users can chat with your AI agent via Telegram, Lark, or Slack.
channels.empty.title: No channels configured yet
channels.empty.description: Channels connect Peers Touch to messaging platforms. Configure a Telegram, Lark, or Slack bot to let users interact with your AI agent directly from their messaging app.
channels.type.lark.label: Lark
channels.type.lark.desc: Connect as a Lark App Bot via WebSocket long connection. No public URL needed.
channels.type.lark.setupGuide:
1. Go to open.feishu.cn → Create App
2. Enable Bot capability
3. Permissions → Add:
   • im:message (send messages)
   • im:message:send_as_bot
   • im:message.p2p_msg:readonly
   • im:message.group_at_msg:readonly
   • im:chat (list chats)
   • im:chat.members:bot_access
4. Event Subscriptions → Enable WebSocket mode → Add:
   • im.message.receive_v1
   • im.chat.member.bot.added_v1
5. Publish & approve the app version
6. Copy App ID and App Secret here
channels.type.telegram.label: Telegram
channels.type.telegram.desc: Connect as a Telegram Bot via long polling. No public URL needed.
channels.type.telegram.setupGuide:
1. Talk to @BotFather on Telegram
2. Send /newbot and follow instructions
3. Copy the bot token here
channels.type.slack.label: Slack
channels.type.slack.desc: Connect as a Slack App via Socket Mode. No public URL needed.
channels.type.slack.setupGuide:
1. Go to api.slack.com → Create New App
2. Enable Socket Mode
3. Subscribe to "message.im" and "app_mention" events
4. Add scopes: chat:write, app_mentions:read, im:history
5. Generate App-Level Token with connections:write
6. Install app to workspace and copy both tokens here
channels.type.discord.label: Discord
channels.type.discord.desc: Connect as a Discord Bot. Supports DMs and server channels.
channels.type.discord.setupGuide:
1. Go to discord.com/developers → New Application
2. Go to Bot → Add Bot → Copy Token
3. Under Privileged Gateway Intents, enable Message Content Intent
4. Go to OAuth2 → URL Generator → Select "bot" scope
5. Select permissions: Send Messages, Read Messages/View Channels
6. Copy the invite URL and add bot to your server
